Name: Dream Weaver (Dream Journal)
Author: AlvarusOnly
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Dream Weaver turns your farmer's daily life into procedurally generated dreams. Every time you sleep, the mod looks at what you actually did that day gold earned, how deep you went into the mines, how much friendship you built, whether it stormed and weaves it into a unique narrative dream that greets you the next morning.  Each dream carries a small, thematic gameplay effect: a Speed boost from a stormy nightmare, extra Luck from a bountiful harvest dream, more Max Stamina from a dream about your friends. On rare days where everything goes right at once, you might get the elusive [b]Golden Dream[/b]. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[quote]1. Install SMAPI if you haven't already.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your   folder the folder structure should look like
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/
DreamWeaver/manifest.json[/code]3. Launch the game via SMAPI.[/quote][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[quote][*][color=#D4D4D8]6 dream themes: Bountiful, Adventurer, Kindred, Stormy, Golden (rare), and Quiet[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Real buffs via the game's own Buff system — Speed, Luck, Max Stamina, Attack, and Defense, not just flavor text[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A small gold gain/loss tied to the dream's mood[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dream Journal — reread your last 16 dreams anytime via a keybind (default: [b]J[/b])[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dreams shown as a proper in-game letter, not a plain text box[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full config support: change the keybind, disable buffs, adjust buff strength, or turn off the gold effect either by editing  or in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional, not required) [/color]

[code]config.json[/code][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Per-player data, so it plays nicely in multiplayer on the host's save[/color]




[/*]
[/quote][*][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[quote][*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.14+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b][/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — for an in-game settings menu
